4c4a3d1052639379bbf6b652a0046c1397b4aace.value: Match low-code users’ skills, support, permitted scope and release authority to the consequences of the applications they build. Distinguish a simpler modelling interface from validated competence to change shared processes or sensitive data use.

4c4a3d1052639379bbf6b652a0046c1397b4aace.value: Socio-technical enactment, automation or low-code delivery and actual received consequences

4c4a3d1052639379bbf6b652a0046c1397b4aace.name: Authority
4c4a3d1052639379bbf6b652a0046c1397b4aace.value: A citizen developer may create within delegated scope; platform access does not confer authority over another function’s commitments or protected data.

fields.name: Reason
fields.value: Field/case evidence informs feasibility, failure or context; its sample and transfer threats remain in the source-table design records.

4df121afd95fcdbd3247db4daa8c7f2d48516d7f.name: Assessment
4df121afd95fcdbd3247db4daa8c7f2d48516d7f.value: Reported field/practitioner evidence establishes examples or interpretive burdens, not a general causal effect or prevalence. Source-table units and dependence apply.

4df9355ff42b2f7a4b9c20e543755cbf6cab4bee.name: Missing function
4df9355ff42b2f7a4b9c20e543755cbf6cab4bee.value: The migrated case has a valid current state and a permissible future under the new definition, with past external effects preserved as facts.

4df9355ff42b2f7a4b9c20e543755cbf6cab4bee.name: Bounded failure
4df9355ff42b2f7a4b9c20e543755cbf6cab4bee.value: The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

4f646faa1a0b694e44436002480e6dd8662d5b8c.name: Justification
4f646faa1a0b694e44436002480e6dd8662d5b8c.value: These sources specify mechanisms or their limitations. Specification and documented version behaviour are not adoption, benefit or a warranty for another engine.

4f7fd68eb998cde6ee731607bc24d97f324c473d.name: Conditions
4f7fd68eb998cde6ee731607bc24d97f324c473d.value: Known source/target semantics, extensions, bindings and lifecycle behaviour.

4f7fd68eb998cde6ee731607bc24d97f324c473d.name: Interpretation
4f7fd68eb998cde6ee731607bc24d97f324c473d.value: Contextual semantic/evidence couplings, not a mandatory installation order or universal requirement to implement every related technique. Exact guarded relations are in COMPOSITION_MODEL.

4fbc4f46f899c08f8815801dd774a9c2e074a75c.name: Bearer
4fbc4f46f899c08f8815801dd774a9c2e074a75c.value: Socio-technical enactment, automation or low-code delivery and actual received consequences

4fbc4f46f899c08f8815801dd774a9c2e074a75c.name: Authority
4fbc4f46f899c08f8815801dd774a9c2e074a75c.value: Automation executes delegated operations; it does not establish the legitimacy of the underlying business decision.

4fed883c3baf9aeb3d7e6f3b4f7587d5c963d77f.name: Mechanism
4fed883c3baf9aeb3d7e6f3b4f7587d5c963d77f.value: Before asserting closure, reconcile the local terminal state with the disposition of work and material external obligations: fulfilled, legitimately waived, transferred or explicitly unresolved under an accepted closure policy.

4fed883c3baf9aeb3d7e6f3b4f7587d5c963d77f.name: Bearer
4fed883c3baf9aeb3d7e6f3b4f7587d5c963d77f.value: Instance closure/termination and dispositions of residual work and external obligations

4fed883c3baf9aeb3d7e6f3b4f7587d5c963d77f.name: Authority
4fed883c3baf9aeb3d7e6f3b4f7587d5c963d77f.value: Local terminal status is not unilateral permission to waive another participant’s commitment.

51eeb2b759981f5cd60e61d2e0b93e08bd5a1fd7.name: Mechanism
51eeb2b759981f5cd60e61d2e0b93e08bd5a1fd7.value: Keep broad deployed benefit unresolved. Retain the narrower formal, simulation and retrospective findings and specify the prospective, multi-setting intervention evidence needed for stronger transfer.

51eeb2b759981f5cd60e61d2e0b93e08bd5a1fd7.name: Bearer
51eeb2b759981f5cd60e61d2e0b93e08bd5a1fd7.value: Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

51eeb2b759981f5cd60e61d2e0b93e08bd5a1fd7.name: Authority
51eeb2b759981f5cd60e61d2e0b93e08bd5a1fd7.value: Researcher and operational evaluator must establish realised effects; a developer’s simulation is not a deployment verdict. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

52538fcc8f90e59fda5ef3b71de09d2d94073f72.name: Mechanism
52538fcc8f90e59fda5ef3b71de09d2d94073f72.value: Present traceable findings and competing explanations to relevant domain participants, including affected parties where people-related claims matter; record corrections, disagreement and evidence requested. Use focused challenge rather than treating agreement as truth.

52538fcc8f90e59fda5ef3b71de09d2d94073f72.name: Bearer
52538fcc8f90e59fda5ef3b71de09d2d94073f72.value: Participant challenge, privacy/fairness, federated computation and output-disclosure boundaries

52538fcc8f90e59fda5ef3b71de09d2d94073f72.name: Authority
52538fcc8f90e59fda5ef3b71de09d2d94073f72.value: Participants contribute situated evidence; authority to decide or revise policy remains distinct from expertise or seniority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

52867dd7fac60e0186cfffcb224a5ad20d747bf9.name: Mechanism
52867dd7fac60e0186cfffcb224a5ad20d747bf9.value: Allow feedback to change a representation, the real work, the measure or the intervention hypothesis, but distinguish these acts. Review their consistency and continuity: updating a diagram does not change work, and changed work may require a revised account without implying improvement.

52867dd7fac60e0186cfffcb224a5ad20d747bf9.name: Bearer
52867dd7fac60e0186cfffcb224a5ad20d747bf9.value: Coupled but distinct revisions of representations, actual work, measures and hypotheses

52867dd7fac60e0186cfffcb224a5ad20d747bf9.name: Authority
52867dd7fac60e0186cfffcb224a5ad20d747bf9.value: Modellers may revise descriptions within their remit; changing operational commitments or evaluation criteria requires the responsible authority.

52fcda4a176c468c01eba858a78f28cd70e1fdc7.name: Reason
52fcda4a176c468c01eba858a78f28cd70e1fdc7.value: Check the stated case structure, data, authority, users, protected outcomes and external effects. A model, survey association or single-case result does not automatically transfer to a new organisation.

539da04fe014db57474587a6bce7f8675362e7b0.name: Mechanism
539da04fe014db57474587a6bce7f8675362e7b0.value: Relate queue policy and escalation to actual capacity, calendars and service needs; surface starvation and overload rather than optimising only local throughput.

539da04fe014db57474587a6bce7f8675362e7b0.name: Bearer
539da04fe014db57474587a6bce7f8675362e7b0.value: Resource/time feasibility and allocation/escalation for enabled work

539da04fe014db57474587a6bce7f8675362e7b0.name: Authority
539da04fe014db57474587a6bce7f8675362e7b0.value: Escalation requests a decision; it does not authorise bypassing duty or competence requirements.

53b73b1cf0c2e0ca550df1ab0796dca87efaec5d.name: Bearer
53b73b1cf0c2e0ca550df1ab0796dca87efaec5d.value: Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

53b73b1cf0c2e0ca550df1ab0796dca87efaec5d.name: Authority
53b73b1cf0c2e0ca550df1ab0796dca87efaec5d.value: Analyst and domain participant decide whether an event class supports the proposed question; data custodians explain recording but do not determine organisational obligations. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

55752ef6460af8a5b14d6e8fc42c122a7e49d2fd.name: Mechanism
55752ef6460af8a5b14d6e8fc42c122a7e49d2fd.value: Separate role eligibility, current authorisation, competence and availability; obtain each needed condition from an appropriate authority rather than from a worklist label.

55752ef6460af8a5b14d6e8fc42c122a7e49d2fd.name: Bearer
55752ef6460af8a5b14d6e8fc42c122a7e49d2fd.value: Actor eligibility/authority/competence, work-item ownership and assignment constraints

55752ef6460af8a5b14d6e8fc42c122a7e49d2fd.name: Authority
55752ef6460af8a5b14d6e8fc42c122a7e49d2fd.value: Workflow assignment records do not create external legal, professional or organisational authority.

55dacdf7e21d281076324fb226e2656f98408feb.name: Mechanism
55dacdf7e21d281076324fb226e2656f98408feb.value: Reassess models, assumptions and measures when demand, case mix, resources, interfaces or actual practices change. Distinguish benign variation from a changed mechanism and avoid updating the model merely to normalise a harmful deviation.

55dacdf7e21d281076324fb226e2656f98408feb.name: Bearer
55dacdf7e21d281076324fb226e2656f98408feb.value: Changed demand, models, practice and assumptions requiring reassessment

55dacdf7e21d281076324fb226e2656f98408feb.name: Authority
55dacdf7e21d281076324fb226e2656f98408feb.value: Analysts identify changed evidence; owners and affected actors decide whether models, operations or objectives need revision.

55e6ef037e671ef7cdddc689c849bfd9c979b83a.name: Mechanism
55e6ef037e671ef7cdddc689c849bfd9c979b83a.value: Establish what each resource identifier denotes and when the mapping changes; distinguish people, roles, teams, systems and accounts. Do not make individual-level claims from a coarser or ambiguous identifier.

55e6ef037e671ef7cdddc689c849bfd9c979b83a.name: Bearer
55e6ef037e671ef7cdddc689c849bfd9c979b83a.value: Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

55e6ef037e671ef7cdddc689c849bfd9c979b83a.name: Authority
55e6ef037e671ef7cdddc689c849bfd9c979b83a.value: Data custodian explains account semantics; affected participants can challenge attribution; analysts do not infer personal identity by convenience. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

56a711921273c4d3d5676734a1343a5a3531ee4b.name: Mechanism
56a711921273c4d3d5676734a1343a5a3531ee4b.value: Do not use original alpha as the universal default. Retain it as an explanatory baseline or for inputs satisfying its scoped conditions; select extensions or alternative miners according to the actual noise, loops and construct requirements.

56a711921273c4d3d5676734a1343a5a3531ee4b.name: Bearer
56a711921273c4d3d5676734a1343a5a3531ee4b.value: Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

56a711921273c4d3d5676734a1343a5a3531ee4b.name: Authority
56a711921273c4d3d5676734a1343a5a3531ee4b.value: Analyst selects the method; foundational status is not evidence that it is the best operational choice. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

582e15308bb44aab0ca4bb3c87749ba76ad0742e.name: Mechanism
582e15308bb44aab0ca4bb3c87749ba76ad0742e.value: Identify the intended result, its recipients and the end-to-end work that produces it. Make competing outcome claims visible before choosing measures or redesigning tasks; a purchaser’s preference is not automatically every affected person’s interest.

582e15308bb44aab0ca4bb3c87749ba76ad0742e.name: Bearer
582e15308bb44aab0ca4bb3c87749ba76ad0742e.value: Process purposes, beneficiaries and strategic outcome commitments

582e15308bb44aab0ca4bb3c87749ba76ad0742e.name: Authority
582e15308bb44aab0ca4bb3c87749ba76ad0742e.value: Responsible managers can commit resources; beneficiaries and affected workers contribute outcome evidence. Analysts cannot decide whose interests prevail merely by drawing the boundary.

58c87a76aea24df86ee711475ad760b341863bdd.name: Bearer
58c87a76aea24df86ee711475ad760b341863bdd.value: AI-assisted/extracted evidence and unresolved or rejected transfers to broad capability/authority

58c87a76aea24df86ee711475ad760b341863bdd.name: Authority
58c87a76aea24df86ee711475ad760b341863bdd.value: Analyst retains responsibility for claims and tool execution; an LLM receives no operative authority from producing a plausible answer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

58fbc11de0c2b8e0449b54a3eba3b11fc6ec274e.name: Assessment
58fbc11de0c2b8e0449b54a3eba3b11fc6ec274e.value: The cited comparisons/cases support the stated component or limitation, not a controlled trial of this mature synthesis. Units and design limits resolve through empirical_evidence in the source table.

5b881ecb68d2b2da4c6d4362bc1d497b4d1bc160.name: Mechanism
5b881ecb68d2b2da4c6d4362bc1d497b4d1bc160.value: Separate traceability and computational reproducibility from semantic, population, model and causal validity. Use auditability to expose assumptions and reproduce a challenge, not as a replacement for evidence about them.

5b881ecb68d2b2da4c6d4362bc1d497b4d1bc160.name: Bearer
5b881ecb68d2b2da4c6d4362bc1d497b4d1bc160.value: Analytical recipes, alternatives, evidence dependencies and validity-preserving handoffs

5b881ecb68d2b2da4c6d4362bc1d497b4d1bc160.name: Authority
5b881ecb68d2b2da4c6d4362bc1d497b4d1bc160.value: Analyst and reviewer use custody evidence to examine claims; no actor receives extra substantive authority merely by maintaining a log. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

5bcc948cd60791d220cd389725651ca6c98fb452.name: Reason
5bcc948cd60791d220cd389725651ca6c98fb452.value: Check the stated case structure, data, authority, users, protected outcomes and external effects. A model, survey association or single-case result does not automatically transfer to a new organisation.

5c6e3aa0f4688f536686ef6e0077d5108415ac3f.name: Justification
5c6e3aa0f4688f536686ef6e0077d5108415ac3f.value: These sources specify mechanisms or their limitations. Specification and documented version behaviour are not adoption, benefit or a warranty for another engine.

5d0f0b9c430318b1b32c0ecd9cfa0ec8a4e59d2f.name: Parent removal
5d0f0b9c430318b1b32c0ecd9cfa0ec8a4e59d2f.value: W031 or B037 can be omitted when the other or a direct adequate account supplies the same relevant premise; W061 inspection can be replaced by an independently checked definition and identity relation. Removal of all such evidence leaves an unresolved case claim rather than a new property.

5d420168f3f0253fbd6589ecf66c8015bf6bc650.name: Mechanism
5d420168f3f0253fbd6589ecf66c8015bf6bc650.value: Simplify a process view according to its communicative purpose, retain access to suppressed detail, and label the result as an abstraction rather than a complete executable specification. Test whether the consumer can answer the intended question.

5d420168f3f0253fbd6589ecf66c8015bf6bc650.name: Bearer
5d420168f3f0253fbd6589ecf66c8015bf6bc650.value: Activity abstraction and analytical representation suited to a consumer

5d420168f3f0253fbd6589ecf66c8015bf6bc650.name: Authority
5d420168f3f0253fbd6589ecf66c8015bf6bc650.value: Analyst constructs the view; participants judge its adequacy for the discussion, not merely its visual attractiveness. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

5e598e078e9929d2d0aa533d6216f611fd6559dc.name: Mechanism
5e598e078e9929d2d0aa533d6216f611fd6559dc.value: On an apparent drift, compare instrumentation, extraction, population and process explanations; inspect the change history and selected raw examples. Revise the process hypothesis only after distinguishing or explicitly retaining these alternatives.

5e598e078e9929d2d0aa533d6216f611fd6559dc.name: Bearer
5e598e078e9929d2d0aa533d6216f611fd6559dc.value: Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

5e598e078e9929d2d0aa533d6216f611fd6559dc.name: Authority
5e598e078e9929d2d0aa533d6216f611fd6559dc.value: Data custodian explains instrumentation; analyst evaluates the observed shift; process authority decides on operational consequences. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

5eeea0072e5564b7dc4944b58c8b1be9cdd7e439.name: Mechanism
5eeea0072e5564b7dc4944b58c8b1be9cdd7e439.value: Define event meaning, identity, ordering and observation scope so histories can support the particular recovery, monitoring or review question.

5eeea0072e5564b7dc4944b58c8b1be9cdd7e439.name: Bearer
5eeea0072e5564b7dc4944b58c8b1be9cdd7e439.value: Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

5eeea0072e5564b7dc4944b58c8b1be9cdd7e439.name: Authority
5eeea0072e5564b7dc4944b58c8b1be9cdd7e439.value: Logging access is not authority to observe every human activity or retain all personal data.

5efa45a335f631959b0de84d0bea743788a7c2dd.name: Mechanism
5efa45a335f631959b0de84d0bea743788a7c2dd.value: Reduce unnecessary representational complexity while preserving decision-relevant behaviour and relationships. Test the simplified form with its users; use modularisation or multiple coordinated views when a single small diagram would conceal essential interactions.

5efa45a335f631959b0de84d0bea743788a7c2dd.name: Bearer
5efa45a335f631959b0de84d0bea743788a7c2dd.value: Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

5efa45a335f631959b0de84d0bea743788a7c2dd.name: Authority
5efa45a335f631959b0de84d0bea743788a7c2dd.value: Modellers propose changes; users and domain experts check that useful meaning has not been lost.

5f951ea12fb161e67670ea458b969cb68668cacd.name: Mechanism
5f951ea12fb161e67670ea458b969cb68668cacd.value: Treat a timed-out action’s effect as unknown until the relevant protocol, idempotency boundary or reconciliation establishes what happened.

5f951ea12fb161e67670ea458b969cb68668cacd.name: Bearer
5f951ea12fb161e67670ea458b969cb68668cacd.value: Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

5f951ea12fb161e67670ea458b969cb68668cacd.name: Authority
5f951ea12fb161e67670ea458b969cb68668cacd.value: Timeout does not authorise a conflicting second action or unilateral reversal.

60d5255d683b209f67c4e09b0e733973a3389868.name: Mechanism
60d5255d683b209f67c4e09b0e733973a3389868.value: Connect each consequential indicator to a decision, a responsible consumer and a feasible action or inquiry. A dashboard can inform action but its production is not itself adaptation or improvement.

60d5255d683b209f67c4e09b0e733973a3389868.name: Bearer
60d5255d683b209f67c4e09b0e733973a3389868.value: Monitoring outputs linked, or not linked, to a capable decision consumer

60d5255d683b209f67c4e09b0e733973a3389868.name: Authority
60d5255d683b209f67c4e09b0e733973a3389868.value: Monitoring analysts provide evidence; authorised owners or professionals decide interventions.

61a84e5b7773e07921e29327d23ef2f550fb677b.name: Mechanism
61a84e5b7773e07921e29327d23ef2f550fb677b.value: Separate materially different cases where this improves fit, but validate classification quality and the burdens imposed on difficult or disadvantaged cases. Reassess class boundaries when demand changes.

61a84e5b7773e07921e29327d23ef2f550fb677b.name: Bearer
61a84e5b7773e07921e29327d23ef2f550fb677b.value: Case coordination, allocation, pooling and segmentation arrangements

61a84e5b7773e07921e29327d23ef2f550fb677b.name: Authority
61a84e5b7773e07921e29327d23ef2f550fb677b.value: Classification and resource-allocation decisions require accountable authority; analysts do not define acceptable exclusion alone.

632c622d6ad7c83cb6025a9fa0a4068c48453d2a.name: Mechanism
632c622d6ad7c83cb6025a9fa0a4068c48453d2a.value: Compare interviews, documents, walkthroughs, direct observation and event evidence where they reveal different aspects of work. Record provenance and disagreement; neither a remembered account, a prescription nor an event log is intrinsically the whole truth.

632c622d6ad7c83cb6025a9fa0a4068c48453d2a.name: Bearer
632c622d6ad7c83cb6025a9fa0a4068c48453d2a.value: Accounts of performed work, variants and observations outside current models

632c622d6ad7c83cb6025a9fa0a4068c48453d2a.name: Authority
632c622d6ad7c83cb6025a9fa0a4068c48453d2a.value: Analysts synthesise evidence; performers and recipients can correct it. Sponsorship does not entitle an analyst to dismiss inconvenient observations.

643eba755c1608b2bf5c2559db036385f48bbac7.name: Mechanism
643eba755c1608b2bf5c2559db036385f48bbac7.value: Permit non-use, narrowed use and retirement when the data cannot support the question, the result cannot affect a legitimate decision, or the harm/cost exceeds its plausible value. State what evidence or changed condition would justify reconsideration.

643eba755c1608b2bf5c2559db036385f48bbac7.name: Bearer
643eba755c1608b2bf5c2559db036385f48bbac7.value: Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

643eba755c1608b2bf5c2559db036385f48bbac7.name: Authority
643eba755c1608b2bf5c2559db036385f48bbac7.value: The accountable consumer and data authority decide whether to proceed; analysts must be able to report an evidence gap without manufacturing a model. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

definitions.64c2d30db678146b3e0edc6a7a5ecb3386408e52: The named question, unit, relationship, meaning or scoped counterexample is actually produced, communicated and consumed in this same case-choice inquiry, and changes that particular premise. Generic labels, attendance, claims of quality and unused or mismatched outputs do not qualify. The question may be specified before a complete event binding or closure result is established; missing other premises retain their own uncertainty.

64e7b1e6b549c9ad617d3114553686a67c74ee87.name: Mechanism
64e7b1e6b549c9ad617d3114553686a67c74ee87.value: Compare control-flow and relevant data/resource/time constraints jointly where the formalism supports them, with explicit cross-perspective costs. Diagnose which interpretation changes when a missing or inconsistent attribute is considered.

64e7b1e6b549c9ad617d3114553686a67c74ee87.name: Bearer
64e7b1e6b549c9ad617d3114553686a67c74ee87.value: Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

64e7b1e6b549c9ad617d3114553686a67c74ee87.name: Authority
64e7b1e6b549c9ad617d3114553686a67c74ee87.value: Analyst establishes joint comparison; domain or rule authority interprets the guard and its consequence. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

fields.name: Reason
fields.value: The mechanism is conceptually or analytically supported; no general formal theorem of organisational success is asserted.

68096b8bfec187294d70ac4491f06014dfc3a3be.name: Justification
68096b8bfec187294d70ac4491f06014dfc3a3be.value: The named model/theorem is bounded; see EWM-F cards and the candidate preconditions. Interaction standards and formal composition results bound local/global semantics. Participant consent, actual receipt and operational cooperation need additional evidence.

fields.name: Reason
fields.value: Field/case evidence informs feasibility, failure or context; its sample and transfer threats remain in the source-table design records.

68ed8683132d1f563c5c836824a03260cf0d4195.name: Mechanism
68ed8683132d1f563c5c836824a03260cf0d4195.value: No universal improvement guarantee is established; use EWM-063’s contextual evaluation, retain measured gains and include failed implementations without treating organisational cancellation as proof of engine malfunction.

68ed8683132d1f563c5c836824a03260cf0d4195.name: Bearer
68ed8683132d1f563c5c836824a03260cf0d4195.value: Contextual or generalised economic/organisational claims about workflow support

68ed8683132d1f563c5c836824a03260cf0d4195.name: Authority
68ed8683132d1f563c5c836824a03260cf0d4195.value: Efficiency rhetoric does not settle whose costs count or legitimise every organisational change.

fields.name: Reason
fields.value: Relevant comparisons concern bounded modelling/simulation or selected before/after deployments, not this complete management property in all contexts.

6a641aa54983c25e2ce8d7de38717d62f21523cd.name: Justification
6a641aa54983c25e2ce8d7de38717d62f21523cd.value: No independent replication establishing this candidate’s general practical payoff was identified in the inspected scope. Shared programme papers, standards and editions are not counted separately.

6aabfee3b0a559571cee83a0f3e0d3136ace8945.name: Current author integration
6aabfee3b0a559571cee83a0f3e0d3136ace8945.value: Current EBPM070 supports a proportionate adequate choice among feasible considered alternatives. BWP-NEW11/12 test protected-function compaction, inadequate cheap deletion and the absence of a global-optimality proof. Every listed actual candidate supplies a function/limit, not a required installation.

6ad14d5a90abe001a4018aa90113b1d593c86bda.name: Mechanism
6ad14d5a90abe001a4018aa90113b1d593c86bda.value: Represent the admitted event uncertainties and compute or approximate lower and upper conformance costs across supported realisations. Report what holds for all, some or none of those realisations without assigning unsupported probabilities.

6ad14d5a90abe001a4018aa90113b1d593c86bda.name: Authority
6ad14d5a90abe001a4018aa90113b1d593c86bda.value: Analyst explains bound semantics; the consumer decides whether the interval is informative enough to act on. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

definitions.6b9727544aca3d0e53661598c1a2395b082af070: Independent event occurrence and object identity, the needed event/object relation, residual correlation ambiguity, case creation and closure, receipt and time meaning, the legitimacy of the consumer question, permissions for consequential action, source credibility beyond the stipulations, and field benefit remain separate burdens. A rejected candidate correlation need not be replaced by a fully established one.

fields.name: Justification
fields.value: Use the exact unit, sample, setting and threats in the linked study cards. Field observation is not proof of a universal mechanism payoff.

definitions.6bc52ef99a5892686628d13d5e9d6e110754de0b: Change to DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE. EWM-003 already states completion meaning, remaining work, residual effects and authorised closure/transfer; EWM-075 supplies no distinct bearer, guard or postcondition at that scope. Preserve the historical candidate and its nine endpoint relations as a conditional elaboration, not an additional required control or independent discovered invariant.
definitions.6bd9cbcc6251f872842880db83de1de281da0194: Limit people-related inference to supported units and legitimate purposes; expose data/metric limitations, assess differential representation and consequences, and provide a meaningful route to challenge or correct material attributions. Treat fairness as a separately specified concern, not a property inferred from conformance.

6cc71f175fa1fd4e59e65e2b0ed6876708cd5443.name: Mechanism
6cc71f175fa1fd4e59e65e2b0ed6876708cd5443.value: Declare the target population and observation window; distinguish cases, events, objects and decision occasions; examine inclusion, censoring, unlogged work and changes in capture. Match the strength of a conclusion to the actual observation process.

6cc71f175fa1fd4e59e65e2b0ed6876708cd5443.name: Bearer
6cc71f175fa1fd4e59e65e2b0ed6876708cd5443.value: Analytical target population, unit and observation/censoring process

6cc71f175fa1fd4e59e65e2b0ed6876708cd5443.name: Authority
6cc71f175fa1fd4e59e65e2b0ed6876708cd5443.value: The consumer accepts or rejects the bounded population claim; the analyst cannot expand it by reporting more decimal places. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

6dab3b7a8858e556e52d1c249445cac0a9a2a153.name: Assessment
6dab3b7a8858e556e52d1c249445cac0a9a2a153.value: Reported field/practitioner evidence establishes examples or interpretive burdens, not a general causal effect or prevalence. Source-table units and dependence apply.

definitions.6e0680268d3b7b5e1aa62254a9d75081b13f8491: Candidate proposition: agents could autonomously revise consequential organisational goals or process policies and enact the changes with accountable long-term outcomes. Bounded process-aware execution and supplied adaptations now have prototype and simulation evidence; transferable autonomous self-revision remains unresolved.

6f2dc68406faaf52e9e574b824b13c65e49e84e7.name: Mechanism
6f2dc68406faaf52e9e574b824b13c65e49e84e7.value: State observational equivalence and the limits of the sampled behaviour. Where competing models make different consequential predictions, seek discriminating data or domain evidence; otherwise retain alternatives or a weaker conclusion rather than asserting unique recovery.

6f2dc68406faaf52e9e574b824b13c65e49e84e7.name: Bearer
6f2dc68406faaf52e9e574b824b13c65e49e84e7.value: Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

6f2dc68406faaf52e9e574b824b13c65e49e84e7.name: Authority
6f2dc68406faaf52e9e574b824b13c65e49e84e7.value: Analyst communicates what is and is not identified; domain evidence can discriminate but must not be silently smuggled into the log. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

6f96420c5905dbbb1bfd782de9c8728ccccfdade.name: Mechanism
6f96420c5905dbbb1bfd782de9c8728ccccfdade.value: Select the initial population and quantifiers explicitly; add fairness, resource, time or ranking assumptions only when the required guarantee actually needs them.

6f96420c5905dbbb1bfd782de9c8728ccccfdade.name: Bearer
6f96420c5905dbbb1bfd782de9c8728ccccfdade.value: Workflow-model verification, soundness quantifiers and proof/reduction assumptions

6f96420c5905dbbb1bfd782de9c8728ccccfdade.name: Authority
6f96420c5905dbbb1bfd782de9c8728ccccfdade.value: Fairness assumptions concern execution policy/environment; a proof cannot compel a human to perform work.

6fdf057928a591feae8edf07ef1df2aa16645f4e.name: Mechanism
6fdf057928a591feae8edf07ef1df2aa16645f4e.value: Involve those performing and receiving work in discovery, redesign and evaluation; provide skills and incentives that permit the intended behaviour. Treat participation as consequential influence and learning, not attendance or consultation without effect.

6fdf057928a591feae8edf07ef1df2aa16645f4e.name: Bearer
6fdf057928a591feae8edf07ef1df2aa16645f4e.value: Participant validation, learning and consequential participation arrangements

6fdf057928a591feae8edf07ef1df2aa16645f4e.name: Authority
6fdf057928a591feae8edf07ef1df2aa16645f4e.value: Sponsors resource participation; performers contribute operational knowledge; consultation does not erase formal accountability.

70f0949bb7abaccd2ed7e41caccf982b5bfea94b.name: Mechanism
70f0949bb7abaccd2ed7e41caccf982b5bfea94b.value: Keep observation windows, event-schema versions, model versions and reference expectations distinguishable; tie a result to the regime in which its assumptions were assessed. Preserve enough prior identity to compare changes or reconstruct a past decision.

70f0949bb7abaccd2ed7e41caccf982b5bfea94b.name: Bearer
70f0949bb7abaccd2ed7e41caccf982b5bfea94b.value: Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

70f0949bb7abaccd2ed7e41caccf982b5bfea94b.name: Authority
70f0949bb7abaccd2ed7e41caccf982b5bfea94b.value: Data and model custodians communicate changes; consumers know which temporal claim a result supports. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

7173b8863d99694ff5292dee4bf6fdab19d64749.name: Assessment
7173b8863d99694ff5292dee4bf6fdab19d64749.value: The cited comparisons/cases support the stated component or limitation, not a controlled trial of this mature synthesis. Units and design limits resolve through empirical_evidence in the source table.

fields.name: Justification
fields.value: The inspected support does not provide a controlled, candidate-isolating effect estimate. Expected payoff remains a reasoned failure-control claim.

727eb6515b65600c98b89fbf4ab861f23360a4f3.name: Mechanism
727eb6515b65600c98b89fbf4ab861f23360a4f3.value: Move an activity only after checking information, resource, commitment and protective dependencies. Early screening can avoid downstream effort, while premature action can create irrecoverable commitments.

727eb6515b65600c98b89fbf4ab861f23360a4f3.name: Authority
727eb6515b65600c98b89fbf4ab861f23360a4f3.value: Operational owners coordinate changes across the functions whose inputs or commitments move.

729cac688fa92d50238fa40afcdfdfa92f97939c.name: Note
729cac688fa92d50238fa40afcdfdfa92f97939c.value: An examined candidate is not a pre-approved obligation. Stress propositions are not attributed to the whole field; composition properties are this researcher’s synthesis.

736189c8c2a7facfe91d587c4d09f4d89cb49c27.name: Assessment
736189c8c2a7facfe91d587c4d09f4d89cb49c27.value: Reported field/practitioner evidence establishes examples or interpretive burdens, not a general causal effect or prevalence. Source-table units and dependence apply.

73d4328904e220393556fdc907003ed9206066fb.name: Assessment
73d4328904e220393556fdc907003ed9206066fb.value: Reported field/practitioner evidence establishes examples or interpretive burdens, not a general causal effect or prevalence. Source-table units and dependence apply.

definitions.74b8133173457c6d04012bbed37f09cb58cf67f5: Change to CONTEXT_DEPENDENT and ANALYTICAL_CONFIGURATION_CRITERION. Coherent cross-version recovery is useful, but no new universal theorem or independently novel protection is established. Identity, effects, retention and code/state continuity couple only when their triggers arise; migration, coexistence and authorised restart are alternatives, with explicit omission tests.

757fa3dd312a71ff6d3b08d6288f3182bf46e250.name: Mechanism
757fa3dd312a71ff6d3b08d6288f3182bf46e250.value: State what initiates the work, what object or case is being advanced and what counts as completion, cancellation or continuing responsibility. Do not force a single stable case identifier or a terminal event onto open-ended knowledge work without justification.

757fa3dd312a71ff6d3b08d6288f3182bf46e250.name: Bearer
757fa3dd312a71ff6d3b08d6288f3182bf46e250.value: Process cases, triggering needs and continuing/completion responsibilities

757fa3dd312a71ff6d3b08d6288f3182bf46e250.name: Authority
757fa3dd312a71ff6d3b08d6288f3182bf46e250.value: Operational owners and recipients define business completion; a system administrator defines only the system’s representational boundary.

75b1da80163e27932b7d6d8e72e7c0df9c047ee1.name: Mechanism
75b1da80163e27932b7d6d8e72e7c0df9c047ee1.value: Track outstanding remedies and their uncertainty separately from the stopped process, with a permitted retry, alternative remedy, transfer or accepted residual outcome.

75b1da80163e27932b7d6d8e72e7c0df9c047ee1.name: Bearer
75b1da80163e27932b7d6d8e72e7c0df9c047ee1.value: Uncertain external effects, retries, compensation, reconciliation and residual obligations

75b1da80163e27932b7d6d8e72e7c0df9c047ee1.name: Authority
75b1da80163e27932b7d6d8e72e7c0df9c047ee1.value: An engine cannot waive external commitments by deleting failed compensation state.

760b6a882a0f230ff71b11101e0064f5d2152a11.name: Mechanism
760b6a882a0f230ff71b11101e0064f5d2152a11.value: Distinguish description, prediction and causal intervention claims. State the proposed mechanism, plausible confounding and comparison; use stronger designs or bounded trials when an observational association could recommend the wrong intervention.

760b6a882a0f230ff71b11101e0064f5d2152a11.name: Bearer
760b6a882a0f230ff71b11101e0064f5d2152a11.value: Intervention hypotheses, comparisons and analytical claim roles

760b6a882a0f230ff71b11101e0064f5d2152a11.name: Authority
760b6a882a0f230ff71b11101e0064f5d2152a11.value: Analysts can identify evidence limits; authorised owners decide on precaution, experimentation or non-intervention.

7633a1b70a98a2bbdeadd7d361c0f623feeac5e5.name: Mechanism
7633a1b70a98a2bbdeadd7d361c0f623feeac5e5.value: Select a case notion according to the question and unit of responsibility; test relevant alternative correlations. When one case cannot retain required object interactions, keep a relational/object-centric representation instead of forcing a convenient identifier.

7633a1b70a98a2bbdeadd7d361c0f623feeac5e5.name: Authority
7633a1b70a98a2bbdeadd7d361c0f623feeac5e5.value: Analyst and domain consumer choose the unit; the database’s primary key is not an automatic answer to the business question. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

fields.name: Justification
fields.value: Use the exact unit, sample, setting and threats in the linked study cards. Field observation is not proof of a universal mechanism payoff.

7944d8975832ca886a66bc55cf2236dfd86dc373.name: Mechanism
7944d8975832ca886a66bc55cf2236dfd86dc373.value: Choose the scale and pace of change by the inadequacy of the current mechanism, uncertainty, transition risk and continuity needs. Consider radical replacement, incremental repair, mixed migration and no change as genuine alternatives.

7944d8975832ca886a66bc55cf2236dfd86dc373.name: Bearer
7944d8975832ca886a66bc55cf2236dfd86dc373.value: Intervention portfolio and chosen scale of change

7944d8975832ca886a66bc55cf2236dfd86dc373.name: Authority
7944d8975832ca886a66bc55cf2236dfd86dc373.value: Sponsors authorise strategic disruption; performers and affected recipients contribute transition and continuity evidence.

79dbe4431707b25202da2be360a9b52c3f7e0199.name: Mechanism
79dbe4431707b25202da2be360a9b52c3f7e0199.value: Use a sound-by-construction structured representation where its expressiveness is adequate; distinguish the construction’s soundness guarantee from conditions for rediscovery and from correspondence to actual work. Record fall-through or noise-handling choices that affect the result.

79dbe4431707b25202da2be360a9b52c3f7e0199.name: Bearer
79dbe4431707b25202da2be360a9b52c3f7e0199.value: Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

79dbe4431707b25202da2be360a9b52c3f7e0199.name: Authority
79dbe4431707b25202da2be360a9b52c3f7e0199.value: Algorithm establishes its scoped construction property; analyst and domain consumer judge whether the representation fits the question. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

7a1fcb5298069908c5b892165b76d5cd98ea6842.name: Mechanism
7a1fcb5298069908c5b892165b76d5cd98ea6842.value: Use only the lifecycle states needed to establish current responsibility, exclusivity or permissible reassignment, and transition them consistently with the work being performed.

7a1fcb5298069908c5b892165b76d5cd98ea6842.name: Bearer
7a1fcb5298069908c5b892165b76d5cd98ea6842.value: Actor eligibility/authority/competence, work-item ownership and assignment constraints

7a1fcb5298069908c5b892165b76d5cd98ea6842.name: Authority
7a1fcb5298069908c5b892165b76d5cd98ea6842.value: Owning a work item establishes coordination responsibility only within the assignment’s authority.

7a8add86509438156380b4c2156a09bf73b726d3.name: Mechanism
7a8add86509438156380b4c2156a09bf73b726d3.value: Assign sufficient continuity of knowledge and responsibility to a case while retaining necessary specialist review and segregation of duties. Compare fewer handoffs with the competence and concentration-of-authority costs of task combination.

7a8add86509438156380b4c2156a09bf73b726d3.name: Bearer
7a8add86509438156380b4c2156a09bf73b726d3.value: Case coordination, allocation, pooling and segmentation arrangements

7a8add86509438156380b4c2156a09bf73b726d3.name: Authority
7a8add86509438156380b4c2156a09bf73b726d3.value: A coordinator may organise contributions without acquiring every professional or financial approval power.

7c11c3c05ec6cf85b8e2223b707eaa25b749f9b2.name: Assessment
7c11c3c05ec6cf85b8e2223b707eaa25b749f9b2.value: The cited comparisons/cases support the stated component or limitation, not a controlled trial of this mature synthesis. Units and design limits resolve through empirical_evidence in the source table.

7c9f1fd574feafdb90fb71160b3368a90267a3d7.name: Mechanism
7c9f1fd574feafdb90fb71160b3368a90267a3d7.value: Specify the scope ended by termination and account for live children, subscriptions, pending work items and transferred external obligations.

7c9f1fd574feafdb90fb71160b3368a90267a3d7.name: Bearer
7c9f1fd574feafdb90fb71160b3368a90267a3d7.value: Instance closure/termination and dispositions of residual work and external obligations

7c9f1fd574feafdb90fb71160b3368a90267a3d7.name: Authority
7c9f1fd574feafdb90fb71160b3368a90267a3d7.value: An enclosing model can terminate only work within its effective control; external parties may need separate requests.

7ccab67748f7fb6814bbd2857029dadfca905542.name: Mechanism
7ccab67748f7fb6814bbd2857029dadfca905542.value: Distinguish legitimate discretion from uncontrolled deviation. Define the goals and constraints that remain binding, who can depart from the ordinary route, and how the decision and its consequences are communicated and reviewed.

7ccab67748f7fb6814bbd2857029dadfca905542.name: Bearer
7ccab67748f7fb6814bbd2857029dadfca905542.value: Knowledge-work support, discretion, variants and binding constraints

7ccab67748f7fb6814bbd2857029dadfca905542.name: Authority
7ccab67748f7fb6814bbd2857029dadfca905542.value: A case worker’s discretion is bounded by professional and organisational authority; a model’s optional task does not confer legal or ethical permission.

7d2b751402b03ac4b56e56d1b2b3f88909d910e7.name: Mechanism
7d2b751402b03ac4b56e56d1b2b3f88909d910e7.value: Select support according to what can be known in advance: goals and information needs, mandatory constraints, planned tasks or a stable flow. Allow structured sub-processes inside knowledge work and avoid making flexibility equivalent to the absence of guidance.

7d2b751402b03ac4b56e56d1b2b3f88909d910e7.name: Authority
7d2b751402b03ac4b56e56d1b2b3f88909d910e7.value: Case workers plan within professional and organisational authority; system flexibility does not grant new powers.

7de1d7f9716a50421187a1d39daa903f768881fe.name: Bearer
7de1d7f9716a50421187a1d39daa903f768881fe.value: The jointly sufficient portfolio of BPM mechanisms, dependencies and costs

7de1d7f9716a50421187a1d39daa903f768881fe.name: Authority
7de1d7f9716a50421187a1d39daa903f768881fe.value: The accountable consumer and affected actors judge adequacy; method specialists do not mandate tools merely because they are standard practice.

7ea344a2851be8e934f8064838386fe75eb0b735.name: Mechanism
7ea344a2851be8e934f8064838386fe75eb0b735.value: Accept an improvement claim only over its declared consequence boundary and protected outcomes. A local gain remains qualified when material receiving-side burdens are unknown; do not aggregate away a harmed group or silently change the boundary to rescue the claim.

7ea344a2851be8e934f8064838386fe75eb0b735.name: Bearer
7ea344a2851be8e934f8064838386fe75eb0b735.value: Outcome/improvement claims over an affected-party consequence boundary

7ea344a2851be8e934f8064838386fe75eb0b735.name: Authority
7ea344a2851be8e934f8064838386fe75eb0b735.value: The party claiming benefit cannot unilaterally accept another party’s material burden as harmless.

7ec2d3053357f8a77ec297787d03b4bb3b954407.name: Mechanism
7ec2d3053357f8a77ec297787d03b4bb3b954407.value: When a branch is cancelled, update join obligations according to the declared scope and activation rather than pretending that cancellation produced a success token.

7ec2d3053357f8a77ec297787d03b4bb3b954407.name: Bearer
7ec2d3053357f8a77ec297787d03b4bb3b954407.value: Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

7ec2d3053357f8a77ec297787d03b4bb3b954407.name: Authority
7ec2d3053357f8a77ec297787d03b4bb3b954407.value: Only the actor entitled to change the coordination obligation may dispense with a required branch.

7f7a70743986d229ef29ab57e57ba8521f3201f4.name: Mechanism
7f7a70743986d229ef29ab57e57ba8521f3201f4.value: Mine supported finite-trace constraints with explicit activation semantics, distinguish satisfaction from meaningful activation, and check redundancy and consistency before interpretation. Treat a discovered constraint as a descriptive hypothesis unless independently authorised.

7f7a70743986d229ef29ab57e57ba8521f3201f4.name: Bearer
7f7a70743986d229ef29ab57e57ba8521f3201f4.value: Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

7f7a70743986d229ef29ab57e57ba8521f3201f4.name: Authority
7f7a70743986d229ef29ab57e57ba8521f3201f4.value: Analyst explains rule semantics; domain participants evaluate meaningful activation; rule authority is a separate decision. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

7fd27f1bd4735d202630b1511c62ca83f98c8fb6.name: Mechanism
7fd27f1bd4735d202630b1511c62ca83f98c8fb6.value: Define the prediction occasion and information available at that moment, including attribute update histories and cross-case state. Construct features and labels accordingly; keep post-outcome or future-derived information outside the predictor and its tuning.

7fd27f1bd4735d202630b1511c62ca83f98c8fb6.name: Bearer
7fd27f1bd4735d202630b1511c62ca83f98c8fb6.value: Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

7fd27f1bd4735d202630b1511c62ca83f98c8fb6.name: Authority
7fd27f1bd4735d202630b1511c62ca83f98c8fb6.value: Predictive analyst establishes temporal eligibility; operational consumer confirms when information and action opportunities actually exist. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

80453cfe15fca02c82f8e40ea11219e1fb417741.name: Mechanism
80453cfe15fca02c82f8e40ea11219e1fb417741.value: Use the process trace to generate candidate bottleneck explanations, then check omitted prerequisites, calendars, case mix and recording practices. Distinguish the location of an observed delay from a supported causal explanation and from an effective remedy.

80453cfe15fca02c82f8e40ea11219e1fb417741.name: Bearer
80453cfe15fca02c82f8e40ea11219e1fb417741.value: Observed/inferred time, queues and candidate bottleneck explanations

80453cfe15fca02c82f8e40ea11219e1fb417741.name: Authority
80453cfe15fca02c82f8e40ea11219e1fb417741.value: Analyst reports the pattern; operational participants provide contextual evidence; authorised managers decide on interventions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

80b27642821bdcd3a97107cd659c638308c6c9e1.name: Mechanism
80b27642821bdcd3a97107cd659c638308c6c9e1.value: Connect each monitored quantity to a decision-maker and a possible action, while preserving scope, uncertainty and incentives.

80b27642821bdcd3a97107cd659c638308c6c9e1.name: Bearer
80b27642821bdcd3a97107cd659c638308c6c9e1.value: Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

80b27642821bdcd3a97107cd659c638308c6c9e1.name: Authority
80b27642821bdcd3a97107cd659c638308c6c9e1.value: Monitoring does not authorise intervention beyond the responsible actor’s powers.

81412c1f3fcdc2139b130a1fbd094674b9434560.name: Justification
81412c1f3fcdc2139b130a1fbd094674b9434560.value: No independent replication establishing this candidate’s general practical payoff was identified in the inspected scope. Shared programme papers, standards and editions are not counted separately.

81cba1dd30ab0aa8b3aaeec5fd1e96cb12418ba4.name: Mechanism
81cba1dd30ab0aa8b3aaeec5fd1e96cb12418ba4.value: Reject perfect fitness as sufficient validity. Test what additional behaviour the model admits and whether the event semantics, population and intended use are supported.

81cba1dd30ab0aa8b3aaeec5fd1e96cb12418ba4.name: Bearer
81cba1dd30ab0aa8b3aaeec5fd1e96cb12418ba4.value: Process-model quality metrics, generalisation targets and comparative evaluation claims

81cba1dd30ab0aa8b3aaeec5fd1e96cb12418ba4.name: Authority
81cba1dd30ab0aa8b3aaeec5fd1e96cb12418ba4.value: Analyst reports the narrow fitness result; consumer requires other evidence for stronger conclusions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

81e8e7bf3824ce76fbe452350981c58a3c57f025.name: Mechanism
81e8e7bf3824ce76fbe452350981c58a3c57f025.value: Recover or revise an instance only with a coherent account of its governing version, current state, pending work, message/effect identities and known external outcomes.

81e8e7bf3824ce76fbe452350981c58a3c57f025.name: Bearer
81e8e7bf3824ce76fbe452350981c58a3c57f025.value: Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

81e8e7bf3824ce76fbe452350981c58a3c57f025.name: Authority
81e8e7bf3824ce76fbe452350981c58a3c57f025.value: Continuity does not grant authority to modify prior commitments or fabricate missing evidence.

821a904c0f0d1e1e126f5213ce41d1581d7ca354.name: Mechanism
821a904c0f0d1e1e126f5213ce41d1581d7ca354.value: Identify the intended result, its recipients and the end-to-end work that produces it. Make competing outcome claims visible before choosing measures or redesigning tasks; a purchaser’s preference is not automatically every affected person’s interest.

821a904c0f0d1e1e126f5213ce41d1581d7ca354.name: Authority
821a904c0f0d1e1e126f5213ce41d1581d7ca354.value: Responsible managers can commit resources; beneficiaries and affected workers contribute outcome evidence. Analysts cannot decide whose interests prevail merely by drawing the boundary.

825708a7689c396f56c49145e9575562046a9af3.name: Justification
825708a7689c396f56c49145e9575562046a9af3.value: No theorem establishing this candidate as a universal property was used. Reference-model object distinctions and executable specifications are direct evidence of conceptual/implementation semantics, not a comparative estimate of benefit.

826060ac410e5fe1ad6b002b238d170d34fa4ed4.name: Mechanism
826060ac410e5fe1ad6b002b238d170d34fa4ed4.value: Select support according to what can be known in advance: goals and information needs, mandatory constraints, planned tasks or a stable flow. Allow structured sub-processes inside knowledge work and avoid making flexibility equivalent to the absence of guidance.

826060ac410e5fe1ad6b002b238d170d34fa4ed4.name: Bearer
826060ac410e5fe1ad6b002b238d170d34fa4ed4.value: Knowledge-work support, discretion, variants and binding constraints

d0e0bf32fefa5c73f9dc143532c1ab7a421d0373.name: Bearer
d0e0bf32fefa5c73f9dc143532c1ab7a421d0373.value: Event/shared-data interpretation and its relationship to actual work

d0e0bf32fefa5c73f9dc143532c1ab7a421d0373.name: Authority
d0e0bf32fefa5c73f9dc143532c1ab7a421d0373.value: Data custodians explain instrumentation; analysts own inference limits; process owners decide whether evidence is adequate for action.

d0f4eb02fc70f2c42da5306f1f197f35c9a71b33.name: Mechanism
d0f4eb02fc70f2c42da5306f1f197f35c9a71b33.value: Specify window/forgetting policy, event arrival order, late-data handling and prefix semantics; expose the trade-off between latency, memory and historical coverage. Assess partial-case conformance as partial rather than pretending the case has ended.

d0f4eb02fc70f2c42da5306f1f197f35c9a71b33.name: Bearer
d0f4eb02fc70f2c42da5306f1f197f35c9a71b33.value: Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

d0f4eb02fc70f2c42da5306f1f197f35c9a71b33.name: Authority
d0f4eb02fc70f2c42da5306f1f197f35c9a71b33.value: Stream analyst or service operator discloses retention and delay to the decision consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

d118f9d22bb615f6f0e2d9827a35dae13dd19fcf.name: Mechanism
d118f9d22bb615f6f0e2d9827a35dae13dd19fcf.value: Declare the portability layer—diagram, interchange syntax, executable subset, data bindings or runtime interaction—and test the layer actually relied upon.

d118f9d22bb615f6f0e2d9827a35dae13dd19fcf.name: Bearer
d118f9d22bb615f6f0e2d9827a35dae13dd19fcf.value: Correspondence among model, interchange, engine and supported semantic level

d118f9d22bb615f6f0e2d9827a35dae13dd19fcf.name: Authority
d118f9d22bb615f6f0e2d9827a35dae13dd19fcf.value: A standard name is not evidence of conformance at every layer or permission to move data.

definitions.d16d62e655c099d62bd3339efb597adecba8b124: Five work cards, three recipient requests and ten event occurrences are different populations in the new construction. Two memberships of a shared event do not create another occurrence. Inspected deployment-local keys can be rejected with a partial identity contradiction while the complete replacement remains unknown; even equal counts can conceal different memberships.

d22b74a3875ca025cbe022c05bb79fd99c3f32b8.name: Mechanism
d22b74a3875ca025cbe022c05bb79fd99c3f32b8.value: Define who reads/writes each relevant value, when binding occurs and whether values are copied, shared or referenced across scopes.

d22b74a3875ca025cbe022c05bb79fd99c3f32b8.name: Bearer
d22b74a3875ca025cbe022c05bb79fd99c3f32b8.value: Task data flow, binding, ownership, freshness and concurrent-update semantics

d22b74a3875ca025cbe022c05bb79fd99c3f32b8.name: Authority
d22b74a3875ca025cbe022c05bb79fd99c3f32b8.value: Workflow scope is not legal or organisational authority; access policy needs its own basis.

d24aea22f62f5d0d1959763bd919269cd184bea4.name: Mechanism
d24aea22f62f5d0d1959763bd919269cd184bea4.value: Separate elapsed time experienced by the case or recipient from active work effort and resource occupancy. Locate waiting, transfer and rework contributions before attributing delay to an actor or deciding which activity to accelerate.

d24aea22f62f5d0d1959763bd919269cd184bea4.name: Authority
d24aea22f62f5d0d1959763bd919269cd184bea4.value: Analysts interpret time evidence with performers; owners can change allocation or handoff arrangements within their authority.

d311efaf144236a19d8e4a766691b79dfb6a4e2b.name: Mechanism
d311efaf144236a19d8e4a766691b79dfb6a4e2b.value: Assess whether eligible resources and time assumptions can support the enabled work, and specify what happens when they cannot.

d311efaf144236a19d8e4a766691b79dfb6a4e2b.name: Bearer
d311efaf144236a19d8e4a766691b79dfb6a4e2b.value: Resource/time feasibility and allocation/escalation for enabled work

d311efaf144236a19d8e4a766691b79dfb6a4e2b.name: Authority
d311efaf144236a19d8e4a766691b79dfb6a4e2b.value: Availability cannot be conjured by assigning a role; escalating does not grant competence or permission.

d3b4607c6f77f26a57e403f8b5a40c5c988fc8ab.name: Conditions
d3b4607c6f77f26a57e403f8b5a40c5c988fc8ab.value: A semantic equivalence criterion for any transformation, not visual neatness alone.

d3b4607c6f77f26a57e403f8b5a40c5c988fc8ab.name: Interpretation
d3b4607c6f77f26a57e403f8b5a40c5c988fc8ab.value: Contextual semantic/evidence couplings, not a mandatory installation order or universal requirement to implement every related technique. Exact guarded relations are in COMPOSITION_MODEL.

d3b6efc391431b1a207aff39123b7bf2bf6ac1bd.name: Mechanism
d3b6efc391431b1a207aff39123b7bf2bf6ac1bd.value: Define the exact event-derived relation and its unit; validate what the metric means with organisational participants and separate technical handoff from social relationship. Prefer aggregates where individual identification is not needed.

d3b6efc391431b1a207aff39123b7bf2bf6ac1bd.name: Bearer
d3b6efc391431b1a207aff39123b7bf2bf6ac1bd.value: Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

d3b6efc391431b1a207aff39123b7bf2bf6ac1bd.name: Authority
d3b6efc391431b1a207aff39123b7bf2bf6ac1bd.value: Analyst describes the operational relation; participants contest interpretation; organisational decisions remain externally accountable. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

d4d642a0df6514f1230a6b14b6c60b02bf2258c6.name: Reason
d4d642a0df6514f1230a6b14b6c60b02bf2258c6.value: Check the stated case structure, data, authority, users, protected outcomes and external effects. A model, survey association or single-case result does not automatically transfer to a new organisation.

d513c9d4d767e687c9e2ed2083cb16d64cdd19a1.name: Mechanism
d513c9d4d767e687c9e2ed2083cb16d64cdd19a1.value: Limit process visibility and automated judgements to a declared purpose with appropriate access, participation and challenge. Examine privacy, surveillance, fairness and worker/recipient burdens as design consequences, not external afterthoughts.

d513c9d4d767e687c9e2ed2083cb16d64cdd19a1.name: Bearer
d513c9d4d767e687c9e2ed2083cb16d64cdd19a1.value: Process visibility, appraisal, incentives and affected-person protection

d513c9d4d767e687c9e2ed2083cb16d64cdd19a1.name: Authority
d513c9d4d767e687c9e2ed2083cb16d64cdd19a1.value: Managers do not acquire unlimited surveillance authority through technical availability; applicable professional, organisational and legal constraints require separate determination.

d5daf8e0e7d0bbdb53b04ed7112a61c32ea375e7.name: Authority
d5daf8e0e7d0bbdb53b04ed7112a61c32ea375e7.value: Analyst computes correspondence; externally entitled actors interpret or amend obligations. No legal ruling or institutional power is inferred from mining.

d628256f9e67b4ec415ee1e502ad63d830ac77fa.name: Reason
d628256f9e67b4ec415ee1e502ad63d830ac77fa.value: The historical formulation and inspected source dates are recorded; this does not establish first-ever invention. Analytical stress/composition records explicitly have no invented historical founder.

d69578e2388e52966862fa4d36673078a01a48e6.name: Mechanism
d69578e2388e52966862fa4d36673078a01a48e6.value: Use domain knowledge to propose constraints, abstractions or candidate interpretations, label its origin and test its consequences against event evidence. Keep observed, inferred and prescribed statements separate when adjusting a model.

d69578e2388e52966862fa4d36673078a01a48e6.name: Bearer
d69578e2388e52966862fa4d36673078a01a48e6.value: Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

d69578e2388e52966862fa4d36673078a01a48e6.name: Authority
d69578e2388e52966862fa4d36673078a01a48e6.value: Domain experts supply contextual knowledge; the relevant institutional actor—not the analyst—authorises prescriptive rules. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

d69e59ac8b951766f5943034ecf030cc3c80ea76.name: Justification
d69e59ac8b951766f5943034ecf030cc3c80ea76.value: The named model/theorem is bounded; see EWM-F cards and the candidate preconditions. Durable/replay documentation and systems papers support implementation-specific guarantees. The strongest scoped result cannot be transferred to uncooperative external actions.

fields.name: Reason
fields.value: The cited source documents the formulation or documented import; shared vocabulary alone is not treated as influence.

definitions.d7c6b199020df7af0a7a4a2bc5c0a701a05c4aa8: No theorem establishing this candidate as a universal property was used. The evidence mixes an older longitudinal programme, recent scientific systems/operational observations and new AI/low-code audits and controlled prototype studies. They are neither equivalent endpoints nor independent replications of one proposition.

d7e6fef49fdb6e725e430b53c83575d0865a11b7.name: Bearer
d7e6fef49fdb6e725e430b53c83575d0865a11b7.value: Formal declarative constraints and history-compatible instance specifications

d7e6fef49fdb6e725e430b53c83575d0865a11b7.name: Authority
d7e6fef49fdb6e725e430b53c83575d0865a11b7.value: Analysts check encoded behaviour; accountable domain actors decide which constraints should apply and whether a departure is authorised.

d82d1dc6da14155b159a8b3fd94fb2c3d08734fb.name: Mechanism
d82d1dc6da14155b159a8b3fd94fb2c3d08734fb.value: Select a modelling form that preserves the needed behaviours and supports an affordable verification/explanation method.

d82d1dc6da14155b159a8b3fd94fb2c3d08734fb.name: Bearer
d82d1dc6da14155b159a8b3fd94fb2c3d08734fb.value: Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

d82d1dc6da14155b159a8b3fd94fb2c3d08734fb.name: Authority
d82d1dc6da14155b159a8b3fd94fb2c3d08734fb.value: Notation choice creates no operational authority.

fields.name: Assessment
fields.value: No independently measured field effect is claimed for this property. Simulation, retrospective benchmarks, proof and implementation are not counted as deployed benefit.

d8d96f67522143fb5aac64e98e153dee53b0c978.name: Assessment
d8d96f67522143fb5aac64e98e153dee53b0c978.value: The cited comparisons/cases support the stated component or limitation, not a controlled trial of this mature synthesis. Units and design limits resolve through empirical_evidence in the source table.

d943e9ee2cfb40753f1e3ac678630dde62aff6fc.name: Evidence qualification
d943e9ee2cfb40753f1e3ac678630dde62aff6fc.value: A mechanism-level rationale, not a measured universal benefit. The evidence mixes an older longitudinal programme, recent scientific systems/operational observations and new AI/low-code audits and controlled prototype studies. They are neither equivalent endpoints nor independent replications of one proposition.

d9499e2c37984d5103ddfb98b1e702e4f3595f04.name: Mechanism
d9499e2c37984d5103ddfb98b1e702e4f3595f04.value: Investigate a workaround’s cause, protected purpose, risks and affected parties before either suppressing it or institutionalising it. Distinguish useful repair, constraint evasion and temporary accommodation, then decide whether to change the system, the work or neither.

d9499e2c37984d5103ddfb98b1e702e4f3595f04.name: Bearer
d9499e2c37984d5103ddfb98b1e702e4f3595f04.value: A workaround and its cause, purpose, risks and authorised disposition

d9499e2c37984d5103ddfb98b1e702e4f3595f04.name: Authority
d9499e2c37984d5103ddfb98b1e702e4f3595f04.value: Performers can explain the workaround; authorised owners and relevant control holders decide its acceptance or replacement.

d96c590e9804972378510274176952c984b567b3.name: Mechanism
d96c590e9804972378510274176952c984b567b3.value: Represent stable object identities and types, event–object participation and needed object–object relations; record qualifiers and temporal attribute changes when relevant. Preserve multiplicity instead of copying a shared event into fictional independent occurrences.

d96c590e9804972378510274176952c984b567b3.name: Bearer
d96c590e9804972378510274176952c984b567b3.value: Analytical case/object identities, relations and projection multiplicities

d96c590e9804972378510274176952c984b567b3.name: Authority
d96c590e9804972378510274176952c984b567b3.value: Data custodians establish identity conventions; analysts communicate relation meaning to the process consumer. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

fields.name: Reason
fields.value: Relevant comparisons concern bounded modelling/simulation or selected before/after deployments, not this complete management property in all contexts.

da56c352235b2924fd254ba7d01f17910450199e.name: R3 scientific integration
da56c352235b2924fd254ba7d01f17910450199e.value: The added consumed outcome/actual-action/regime operand can change this group's receiving warrant, with forward use independent of a return. Each return needs an actual result and source use. Compatible units, causal identification, authority and joint sufficiency remain separate; no mandatory conjunction follows.

da915a300b6fa92e279aa36188aaa8c3a0ceeaf6.name: Justification
da915a300b6fa92e279aa36188aaa8c3a0ceeaf6.value: No theorem establishing this candidate as a universal property was used. Resource patterns distinguish lifecycle/assignment concepts; qualitative work studies and the assignment-satisfiability formulation answer different questions from timed human performance.

daf76f0dd6382b1974b70cafdbc22cdbe1ffed47.name: Mechanism
daf76f0dd6382b1974b70cafdbc22cdbe1ffed47.value: Identify the observation boundary and connect consequential claims to an appropriate external or participant source; preserve uncertainty when correspondence cannot be checked.

daf76f0dd6382b1974b70cafdbc22cdbe1ffed47.name: Bearer
daf76f0dd6382b1974b70cafdbc22cdbe1ffed47.value: Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

daf76f0dd6382b1974b70cafdbc22cdbe1ffed47.name: Authority
daf76f0dd6382b1974b70cafdbc22cdbe1ffed47.value: An observer need not have authority to act, and a model’s certainty cannot replace a participant’s legitimate judgement.

dced73139a67476ba9a647c4f74c65ab263ca180.name: Missing function
dced73139a67476ba9a647c4f74c65ab263ca180.value: A drift disposition states whether evidence supports process change, observation change, both or an unresolved mixture.

dced73139a67476ba9a647c4f74c65ab263ca180.name: Bounded failure
dced73139a67476ba9a647c4f74c65ab263ca180.value: The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

dd221fb72bf466d8f04553774c8f6a6f25846043.name: Reason
dd221fb72bf466d8f04553774c8f6a6f25846043.value: Check the stated case structure, data, authority, users, protected outcomes and external effects. A model, survey association or single-case result does not automatically transfer to a new organisation.

fields.name: Reason
fields.value: Field/case evidence informs feasibility, failure or context; its sample and transfer threats remain in the source-table design records.

df3fea23805510206105f96269a950fbe1bdc273.name: Mechanism
df3fea23805510206105f96269a950fbe1bdc273.value: Evaluate predictive utility at actual decision times, accounting for lead time, false alarms, intervention capacity and opportunity cost. Choose thresholds or policies against an explicit decision objective rather than accuracy alone.

df3fea23805510206105f96269a950fbe1bdc273.name: Bearer
df3fea23805510206105f96269a950fbe1bdc273.value: Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

df3fea23805510206105f96269a950fbe1bdc273.name: Authority
df3fea23805510206105f96269a950fbe1bdc273.value: Operational authority specifies available actions and resource limits; the analyst evaluates decision support within those bounds. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

dfa171fe6c7d3a6d7673e93309f260f2a5615ac0.name: Mechanism
dfa171fe6c7d3a6d7673e93309f260f2a5615ac0.value: Define the intervention, outcome and comparison; state the identification assumptions and assess confounding, treatment availability, temporal order and support. Use experimental or suitably justified causal evidence for interventional claims, and otherwise present recommendations as hypotheses requiring evaluation.

fields.name: Missing function
fields.value: The completion evidence supports the exact claim being made, with unresolved uncertainty visible.

fields.name: Bounded failure
fields.value: The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

e04527697c972d8ba50208049379749c6f9f2e84.name: Mechanism
e04527697c972d8ba50208049379749c6f9f2e84.value: Identify lifecycle phases and pairing rules; separate enabled, started, suspended, resumed and completed states where actually observed. Compute service or waiting intervals only from phases whose meaning supports them, and label unobserved intervals as unknown.

e04527697c972d8ba50208049379749c6f9f2e84.name: Bearer
e04527697c972d8ba50208049379749c6f9f2e84.value: Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

e04527697c972d8ba50208049379749c6f9f2e84.name: Authority
e04527697c972d8ba50208049379749c6f9f2e84.value: Performance analyst and operational staff distinguish recorded elapsed time from effort before staffing or redesign decisions. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

e0b374dc81d876effb046b89c9252a71bdc9a070.name: Mechanism
e0b374dc81d876effb046b89c9252a71bdc9a070.value: Connect responsibility for the process outcome with sufficient influence, knowledge, resources and an escalation route across participating functions. Separate an owner title from the powers actually exercised.

e0b374dc81d876effb046b89c9252a71bdc9a070.name: Bearer
e0b374dc81d876effb046b89c9252a71bdc9a070.value: Process governance arrangements and exercised authority

e0b374dc81d876effb046b89c9252a71bdc9a070.name: Authority
e0b374dc81d876effb046b89c9252a71bdc9a070.value: The process owner acts within delegated powers; functional and professional authorities retain powers not transferred. Conflicts require negotiation or escalation, not fictitious unilateral control.

e1806924e4a130d046d944fc76aa3c3d70ab3eb0.name: Missing function
e1806924e4a130d046d944fc76aa3c3d70ab3eb0.value: An interventional claim states why the observational or experimental evidence identifies the proposed effect, and where it does not.

e1806924e4a130d046d944fc76aa3c3d70ab3eb0.name: Bounded failure
e1806924e4a130d046d944fc76aa3c3d70ab3eb0.value: The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

e216299f8adfe33f423d2243f6172ade7ed54808.name: Mechanism
e216299f8adfe33f423d2243f6172ade7ed54808.value: Examine demand, service variation, shared capacity and allocation rules together before adding resources or seeking maximum utilisation. Use a queueing model or simulation only when its assumptions represent the relevant work; recheck the end-to-end constraint after a local change.

e216299f8adfe33f423d2243f6172ade7ed54808.name: Bearer
e216299f8adfe33f423d2243f6172ade7ed54808.value: Capacity/queueing/simulation model and conditional intervention predictions

e216299f8adfe33f423d2243f6172ade7ed54808.name: Authority
e216299f8adfe33f423d2243f6172ade7ed54808.value: Resource managers can change capacity and assignment; analysts supply conditional predictions, not authority to alter staffing or worker obligations.

definitions.e2537edb9c3efc08cc44d3ad7d45e89e46c93ec0: For each event class, establish what happened or was recorded, by whom or what, at which lifecycle phase, and with what relation to an actual work episode. Test a small number of material examples against source-system behaviour and domain testimony; preserve unresolved alternatives rather than inventing execution semantics.

e2c4ae2a64e0e9f70a475b4dfb7c3f425e34d0e6.name: Bearer
e2c4ae2a64e0e9f70a475b4dfb7c3f425e34d0e6.value: AI-assisted/extracted evidence and unresolved or rejected transfers to broad capability/authority

e2c4ae2a64e0e9f70a475b4dfb7c3f425e34d0e6.name: Authority
e2c4ae2a64e0e9f70a475b4dfb7c3f425e34d0e6.value: Extractor proposes records; analyst/domain reviewer establishes admissibility for the intended claim; narrative authorship does not guarantee factual correctness. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

e3321b37dbe755655fb119bdfa2a1eca84971d7e.name: Mechanism
e3321b37dbe755655fb119bdfa2a1eca84971d7e.value: Keep three linked but non-equivalent claims explicit: evidence supports a distinction about work; an identified actor is authorised and able to intervene; observed consequences support an outcome judgement. Require the missing link to be established before promoting one claim into another.

e3d152b3a92780e54687d4a9d3e48463f2b5b8e4.name: Missing function
e3d152b3a92780e54687d4a9d3e48463f2b5b8e4.value: Post-intervention claims cite evidence from the relevant regime and do not recycle an invalidated pre-intervention evaluation.

e3d152b3a92780e54687d4a9d3e48463f2b5b8e4.name: Bounded failure
e3d152b3a92780e54687d4a9d3e48463f2b5b8e4.value: The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

e5223deda18cd34eae36c0adc4f54236afa51fd9.name: Assessment
e5223deda18cd34eae36c0adc4f54236afa51fd9.value: Reported field/practitioner evidence establishes examples or interpretive burdens, not a general causal effect or prevalence. Source-table units and dependence apply.

e5788f206d717e08645c60e67eecf6d0ac1dec97.name: Mechanism
e5788f206d717e08645c60e67eecf6d0ac1dec97.value: Check the actual marking, data, completed work, pending interactions and relevant constraints when migrating an instance; a sound new definition alone is insufficient.

e5788f206d717e08645c60e67eecf6d0ac1dec97.name: Bearer
e5788f206d717e08645c60e67eecf6d0ac1dec97.value: Durable/replay/migration continuity of an instance, governing version and external references

e5788f206d717e08645c60e67eecf6d0ac1dec97.name: Authority
e5788f206d717e08645c60e67eecf6d0ac1dec97.value: Migration permission must cover changed obligations, not just permission to edit a diagram.

e5a029890d6715096b9793641c85b77bbb242bc7.name: Mechanism
e5a029890d6715096b9793641c85b77bbb242bc7.value: Reassess models, assumptions and measures when demand, case mix, resources, interfaces or actual practices change. Distinguish benign variation from a changed mechanism and avoid updating the model merely to normalise a harmful deviation.

e5a029890d6715096b9793641c85b77bbb242bc7.name: Authority
e5a029890d6715096b9793641c85b77bbb242bc7.value: Analysts identify changed evidence; owners and affected actors decide whether models, operations or objectives need revision.

e66b10424ee2e82f09ea9b7f1ff61fe932bc2080.name: Assessment
e66b10424ee2e82f09ea9b7f1ff61fe932bc2080.value: The cited comparisons/cases support the stated component or limitation, not a controlled trial of this mature synthesis. Units and design limits resolve through empirical_evidence in the source table.

e9a99e55d5cc95a7bcf0a92e70c597deaa034265.name: Mechanism
e9a99e55d5cc95a7bcf0a92e70c597deaa034265.value: Do not export dashboard possession as an obligation. Evaluate whether a representation supports the actual traceable inference and consumer interaction; keep the tool only if it earns that role.

e9a99e55d5cc95a7bcf0a92e70c597deaa034265.name: Bearer
e9a99e55d5cc95a7bcf0a92e70c597deaa034265.value: Analytical results, decision consumers and continuation/return/non-use claims

e9a99e55d5cc95a7bcf0a92e70c597deaa034265.name: Authority
e9a99e55d5cc95a7bcf0a92e70c597deaa034265.value: Consumer evaluates function; vendor or project branding does not establish analytical authority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

e9c0d198e4ff96e4038d622ae85401c5e614eaed.name: Mechanism
e9c0d198e4ff96e4038d622ae85401c5e614eaed.value: Match the experimental unit, split and comparison to the intended inference; isolate test information from tuning, preserve appropriate temporal availability, include meaningful baselines and account for failures/timeouts. State exactly what the dataset collection can and cannot represent.

ea48147969468a86b912fa4102f55911dd67455d.name: Justification
ea48147969468a86b912fa4102f55911dd67455d.value: No theorem establishing this candidate as a universal property was used. Data patterns and data-centred models identify information/identity mechanisms. Field prevalence and economic effect of a particular binding policy remain poorly established by the inspected corpus.
