fields.value: No direct controlled comparison of this exact property is established by the inspected sources; conceptual retention is not a fabricated effect estimate.

eaba9ac2f32ee482c4f061626de16186659a2d77.name: Bearer
eaba9ac2f32ee482c4f061626de16186659a2d77.value: Conformance reference, mapping, diagnosis and authorised interpretation/repair

eaba9ac2f32ee482c4f061626de16186659a2d77.name: Authority
eaba9ac2f32ee482c4f061626de16186659a2d77.value: Analyst computes correspondence; externally entitled actors interpret or amend obligations. No legal ruling or institutional power is inferred from mining.

eae2d10bc20fee20c5fa1ec2104cca0f81e78b4e.name: Mechanism
eae2d10bc20fee20c5fa1ec2104cca0f81e78b4e.value: Reject the universal claim; compare appropriate baselines on valid task-specific splits, including inference cost, data needs, interpretability and timing.

eae2d10bc20fee20c5fa1ec2104cca0f81e78b4e.name: Bearer
eae2d10bc20fee20c5fa1ec2104cca0f81e78b4e.value: Prediction occasions, available features, calibration and predictive evaluation/utility

eae2d10bc20fee20c5fa1ec2104cca0f81e78b4e.name: Authority
eae2d10bc20fee20c5fa1ec2104cca0f81e78b4e.value: Analyst supplies evidence; consumer judges cost and decision relevance rather than accepting architectural prestige. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

eb91ed9ad23e2bf09171ac651e1d17f88a2b4016.name: Conditions
eb91ed9ad23e2bf09171ac651e1d17f88a2b4016.value: Access to actual definitions, extension behaviour and the semantic subset relied upon.

eb91ed9ad23e2bf09171ac651e1d17f88a2b4016.name: Interpretation
eb91ed9ad23e2bf09171ac651e1d17f88a2b4016.value: Contextual semantic/evidence couplings, not a mandatory installation order or universal requirement to implement every related technique. Exact guarded relations are in COMPOSITION_MODEL.

ebc5b49d97d833ed7bb6cdbfbc3a9817ae4e5004.name: Lost specific support
ebc5b49d97d833ed7bb6cdbfbc3a9817ae4e5004.value: Advice states its recipient, feasibility conditions and evaluation basis; acceptance and actual execution are distinguishable.

ebc5b49d97d833ed7bb6cdbfbc3a9817ae4e5004.name: Reason
ebc5b49d97d833ed7bb6cdbfbc3a9817ae4e5004.value: At least one listed carrier or part of the relational criterion remains; removal may weaken a realisation but does not establish novelty.

f0e19952b29b559f220fb86c805ae5ebc0a957c7.name: Justification
f0e19952b29b559f220fb86c805ae5ebc0a957c7.value: These sources specify mechanisms or their limitations. Specification and documented version behaviour are not adoption, benefit or a warranty for another engine.

fields.name: Reason
fields.value: Field/case evidence informs feasibility, failure or context; its sample and transfer threats remain in the source-table design records.

f1a6375cb54c6a5b2a62dfc34b46dfa76a00afa4.name: Mechanism
f1a6375cb54c6a5b2a62dfc34b46dfa76a00afa4.value: Compare like with like where possible, disclose subgroup and case-mix differences, and examine how selection, censoring and task allocation affect the result. When comparability fails, narrow the claim instead of normalising away inconvenient differences.

f1a6375cb54c6a5b2a62dfc34b46dfa76a00afa4.name: Bearer
f1a6375cb54c6a5b2a62dfc34b46dfa76a00afa4.value: Resource/people identifiers, social inferences and subgroup/case-mix comparisons

f1a6375cb54c6a5b2a62dfc34b46dfa76a00afa4.name: Authority
f1a6375cb54c6a5b2a62dfc34b46dfa76a00afa4.value: Analyst identifies comparability limits; affected participants and accountable decision makers assess the meaning and acceptable use. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

f55dc406749e398f52ac3d1d9191870ca2d20927.name: Mechanism
f55dc406749e398f52ac3d1d9191870ca2d20927.value: Separate elapsed time experienced by the case or recipient from active work effort and resource occupancy. Locate waiting, transfer and rework contributions before attributing delay to an actor or deciding which activity to accelerate.

f55dc406749e398f52ac3d1d9191870ca2d20927.name: Bearer
f55dc406749e398f52ac3d1d9191870ca2d20927.value: Elapsed process time, effort and resource occupancy claims

f55dc406749e398f52ac3d1d9191870ca2d20927.name: Authority
f55dc406749e398f52ac3d1d9191870ca2d20927.value: Analysts interpret time evidence with performers; owners can change allocation or handoff arrangements within their authority.

definitions.f59d64bfdc12eac699c8396c261e86d6b0b0d6d1: No new contribution follows from absent production, absent communication, unused content, a different population or period, a bare label, or a payload that changes no case-choice premise. An already adequate identifier, direct conversation, scoped codebook or small relation table can suffice. A pure event-row count may not use a case notion at all. No automatic reverse or mandatory feedback architecture follows.
definitions.f6e4141550342ebac07ab703eb9441e9501ee6a6: Omit or retire this mechanism when its trigger no longer holds, a cheaper adequate path meets the stated postcondition, or the intended consumer disappears; preserve evidence needed for existing consequential decisions. For a non-retained candidate, retirement means dropping the overclaim, not its valid supporting techniques.

f78d64671bc52bf0844b9e9ef7934c951d9c3f64.name: Mechanism
f78d64671bc52bf0844b9e9ef7934c951d9c3f64.value: Bind and disclose the environment needed to interpret a decision or continuation, and evaluate declared compatibility before combining outputs from changed environments.

f78d64671bc52bf0844b9e9ef7934c951d9c3f64.name: Bearer
f78d64671bc52bf0844b9e9ef7934c951d9c3f64.value: Low-code/agent-produced workflow artefacts and their execution/semantic-environment boundaries

f78d64671bc52bf0844b9e9ef7934c951d9c3f64.name: Authority
f78d64671bc52bf0844b9e9ef7934c951d9c3f64.value: A compatibility declaration is not proof of correctness and cannot authorise its own acceptance.

f7cf3f4056d10691828773cd809cce9cdf249d97.name: Mechanism
f7cf3f4056d10691828773cd809cce9cdf249d97.value: Discover or analyse bounded fragments with explicit event selection and boundary semantics; identify shared events and interactions omitted by the decomposition. Recompose only when compatibility and the consumer’s global question are actually addressed.

f7cf3f4056d10691828773cd809cce9cdf249d97.name: Bearer
f7cf3f4056d10691828773cd809cce9cdf249d97.value: Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

f7cf3f4056d10691828773cd809cce9cdf249d97.name: Authority
f7cf3f4056d10691828773cd809cce9cdf249d97.value: Analyst communicates what a local result does not say; the consumer decides whether a global conclusion is needed. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

f7db3ffb87d3f15774871c9228e456149b121d6c.name: Mechanism
f7db3ffb87d3f15774871c9228e456149b121d6c.value: Maintain a distinction between the model describing recent behaviour and any stable or separately authorised reference. Compare them, diagnose change and obtain the relevant decision before amending obligations; adaptation of description is not self-authorising revision.

f7db3ffb87d3f15774871c9228e456149b121d6c.name: Bearer
f7db3ffb87d3f15774871c9228e456149b121d6c.value: Time-regime-bound logs/models/references, drift and streaming/adaptation claims

f7db3ffb87d3f15774871c9228e456149b121d6c.name: Authority
f7db3ffb87d3f15774871c9228e456149b121d6c.value: Analyst may update a descriptive estimate within scope; rule owners or other entitled actors decide whether the intended process changes. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

f89fdb7cfd73dd6cbeb4ad24780015d327dc5979.name: Mechanism
f89fdb7cfd73dd6cbeb4ad24780015d327dc5979.value: Use the strongest ordering supported by the evidence: a total order where justified, an explicit partial order or bounded alternatives otherwise. Keep tie-breaking separate from observed chronology and test sensitivity when an algorithm requires a sequence.

f89fdb7cfd73dd6cbeb4ad24780015d327dc5979.name: Bearer
f89fdb7cfd73dd6cbeb4ad24780015d327dc5979.value: Event records, source/extraction/lifecycle/order semantics and collection/format policies

f89fdb7cfd73dd6cbeb4ad24780015d327dc5979.name: Authority
f89fdb7cfd73dd6cbeb4ad24780015d327dc5979.value: Analyst exposes ordering alternatives to the consumer; system timestamps alone do not settle the real chronology. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

f8b831de953faf7129403b4cd8378df03e255bf0.name: Assessment
f8b831de953faf7129403b4cd8378df03e255bf0.value: The cited comparisons/cases support the stated component or limitation, not a controlled trial of this mature synthesis. Units and design limits resolve through empirical_evidence in the source table.

f900c1c4974c94b7ecbe30badf24126b6b519542.name: Mechanism
f900c1c4974c94b7ecbe30badf24126b6b519542.value: Record when recommendations or interventions alter exposure, action selection or outcomes; reassess predictive, calibration and causal claims against the new regime. Preserve the prior evaluation as historical evidence and explicitly test the revised policy or narrow its use.

f900c1c4974c94b7ecbe30badf24126b6b519542.name: Bearer
f900c1c4974c94b7ecbe30badf24126b6b519542.value: Intervention identification, recommendation feasibility and post-intervention/deployment claims

f900c1c4974c94b7ecbe30badf24126b6b519542.name: Authority
f900c1c4974c94b7ecbe30badf24126b6b519542.value: Analyst identifies changed validity conditions; operational authority decides continued use, revision or retirement based on new evidence. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

f93f2c379d9173497f975a22f237cf5b90381d73.name: Justification
f93f2c379d9173497f975a22f237cf5b90381d73.value: The named model/theorem is bounded; see EWM-F cards and the candidate preconditions. Patterns and formal workflow languages specify behaviours under their stated context assumptions. Historical feature comparisons and counterexamples do not establish the best engine for a present task.

faa0fb437fe2dc8c9ee0ebeaab4c3cea4840d085.name: Mechanism
faa0fb437fe2dc8c9ee0ebeaab4c3cea4840d085.value: Distinguish repeated activations and recursive parent-child scopes, define exit conditions and separate the existence of an exit path from inevitable termination.

faa0fb437fe2dc8c9ee0ebeaab4c3cea4840d085.name: Bearer
faa0fb437fe2dc8c9ee0ebeaab4c3cea4840d085.value: Workflow control-flow, activation scopes, concurrency, repeated work and arbitration

faa0fb437fe2dc8c9ee0ebeaab4c3cea4840d085.name: Authority
faa0fb437fe2dc8c9ee0ebeaab4c3cea4840d085.value: Re-entry does not renew expired external authority automatically.

definitions.faeb44d2d697a264138ec9ead3c4770a3488c675: Split at the unit and time boundary appropriate to the deployment claim; ensure training outcomes were available then, keep dependent prefixes together where required, and disclose censoring, length restrictions and exclusions. Report performance by meaningful decision horizon and compare an adequate simple baseline.

fb0df549c0198c24d14e671ed81cad4ff285d20e.name: Missing function
fb0df549c0198c24d14e671ed81cad4ff285d20e.value: The benefit claim is accepted, rejected or bounded to what the evidence supports, including unknown external effects.

fb0df549c0198c24d14e671ed81cad4ff285d20e.name: Bounded failure
fb0df549c0198c24d14e671ed81cad4ff285d20e.value: The originating claim loses this support when its trigger is present and no substitute supplies it.

fb2347c33273a7715917e5e26483dfce253b637f.name: Mechanism
fb2347c33273a7715917e5e26483dfce253b637f.value: Use analytical outputs as evidence for accountable inquiry and intervention, preserving data, causal and organisational limits. Distinguish descriptive pattern, predictive performance, feasible intervention and achieved outcome.

fb2347c33273a7715917e5e26483dfce253b637f.name: Bearer
fb2347c33273a7715917e5e26483dfce253b637f.value: Intervention hypotheses, comparisons and analytical claim roles

fb2347c33273a7715917e5e26483dfce253b637f.name: Authority
fb2347c33273a7715917e5e26483dfce253b637f.value: Analysts and tools generate evidence or recommendations; process actors retain responsibility for actions and consequences.

fbcfab806a59c993e65086b52dbbe983a92a1868.name: Mechanism
fbcfab806a59c993e65086b52dbbe983a92a1868.value: Choose the representation and abstraction by the decision it must support and the people who must use it. Preserve the distinctions needed for that task; a narrative, table, decision model, process graph or case representation can be adequate without being interchangeable.

fbcfab806a59c993e65086b52dbbe983a92a1868.name: Bearer
fbcfab806a59c993e65086b52dbbe983a92a1868.value: Process representations and the distinctions/quality claims supported by them

fbcfab806a59c993e65086b52dbbe983a92a1868.name: Authority
fbcfab806a59c993e65086b52dbbe983a92a1868.value: The intended users help judge fitness; a notation specialist cannot infer business authority from technical sophistication.

fc27f7cf3efb1fe282b7f13efd64f896e1787fb0.name: Mechanism
fc27f7cf3efb1fe282b7f13efd64f896e1787fb0.value: Choose the exact object-centric formalism and required guarantee; distinguish type-level tokens from identifier-aware semantics and prove or test only the obligations that formalism states. Treat discovery, soundness and correspondence to real interactions as different claims.

fc27f7cf3efb1fe282b7f13efd64f896e1787fb0.name: Bearer
fc27f7cf3efb1fe282b7f13efd64f896e1787fb0.value: Discovery procedure/model, language/bias, observational support and fragment/global claims

fc27f7cf3efb1fe282b7f13efd64f896e1787fb0.name: Authority
fc27f7cf3efb1fe282b7f13efd64f896e1787fb0.value: Model analyst establishes formal properties; domain participants check identity interpretations; neither formal result grants intervention authority. Analytical competence does not itself supply additional organisational authority.

fc6a6cc4d53e3769df053281cb612f28805cc2d8.name: Assessment
fc6a6cc4d53e3769df053281cb612f28805cc2d8.value: Reported field/practitioner evidence establishes examples or interpretive burdens, not a general causal effect or prevalence. Source-table units and dependence apply.

fields.name: Justification
fields.value: These sources specify mechanisms or their limitations. Specification and documented version behaviour are not adoption, benefit or a warranty for another engine.

fe141d40a17510673044508c140e740c145c76df.name: Mechanism
fe141d40a17510673044508c140e740c145c76df.value: No such general property exists; scope the history to observed events and couple stronger claims to appropriate external evidence.

fe141d40a17510673044508c140e740c145c76df.name: Bearer
fe141d40a17510673044508c140e740c145c76df.value: Execution histories, conformance/monitoring observations and event-to-world claims

fe141d40a17510673044508c140e740c145c76df.name: Authority
fe141d40a17510673044508c140e740c145c76df.value: An internal record cannot overrule facts or testimony it never observed merely by being durable.
